decision.reason: [ev-177a6106bc02] says only that HTTP/3 was moved "outside the experimental section". That describes a configuration option moving to a new place, not a change in how HTTP/3 behaves on the wire, so protocol-behavior:http3 with behavior-changed does not fit what the text says. The right assertion is probably a renamed or removed config option, but the excerpt does not give the old or new option path, or say whether the old experimental setting is still accepted. To decide, I'd need the PR #9570 diff or the v3 migration guide entry for this change.
